text: I'm Adele Andrade Stadler and I'm running for re-election to Alhambra City Council District 5.
I want to build on my record of getting things done for our community.

During this term I initiated the first inclusionary housing ordinance to require developers to include affordable housing in their plan. I secured funding for the first supportive housing project with 44 units for low income families. I initiated the first community workforce agreement, including 100 Unions. I initiated the smoke-free housing ordinance and banned the sale of flavored tobacco to our schoolchildren. I secured funding for the pedestrian safety and bike plan and created a traffic calming ordinance to address neighborhood traffic and environmental impacts. I will support workforce housing for Teachers, Nurses, Construction, and essential workers.

I will continue safeguarding our families and build on our neighborhood watch successes. I will continue to support broad community engagement and collaborate with partnerships to invest in our city. I will continue to respect our diverse community, by supporting multilingual resources. Alhambra has challenges, and opportunities. We must work together to shape a better future for Alhambra.
VOTE Adele Andrade-Stadler For City Council District 5 Adele4Alhambra.com

text: Hello my name is Alejandro Covarrubias. I work as a commercial plumber and I have first hand experience on building, maintaining, and updating infrastructure in places like government buildings, schools, and office buildings.
One of our primary priorities is to help the next generation of workers in gaining meaningful employment in the trades. We would bring trade workshops and promote trade schools.

text: Born to a South American immigrant family, I know what it's like to struggle. I moved to Alhambra before the 2008 recession and have watched families work hard to protect their QUALITY OF LIFE.
As a college civics and ESL professor, I help immigrants and working adults build better futures.
Alhambra deserves leadership that puts RESIDENTS, SMALL BUSINESSES, and TAXPAYERS first—NOT developers, special interests, or machine politics.
I'll be a STRONG, INDEPENDENT VOICE in City Hall, focused on

Neighborhood safety and character
Helping small businesses thrive
Improving quality of life
Traffic and sustainability
Transparency and fiscal accountability
I'll listen, ask tough questions, and make decisions based on FACTS and DATA.

I've championed campaign finance reform, government accountability, and environmental stewardship; served on the city's first historic preservation commission; lead the successful effort to stop a MASSIVE luxury housing project on polluted land; and fought to save Alhambra's last urban forest.
As an ANTI-CORRUPTION CANDIDATE, I accept NO contributions from developers, corporations, or PACs because I always put #PeopleOverProfits.
I want to SERVE MY NEIGHBORS, not build a political career. I respectfully ask for your vote.
